BOAR is an offline-first mobile AI system exploring adaptive model routing, local retrieval, and resource-aware inference. It runs local LLM inference with llama.cpp, built into the app, and local hybrid retrieval (SQLite FTS5 + on-device embeddings) with zero cloud dependencies.
News and updates are posted on our official website. Don\'t fall for scams: check the address before you download anything that says it is BOAR.
Press and hold an address to copy it.
Offline AI research on your phone. Answers with sources, no signal needed. Open source (MIT).
When AI lives only on someone else\'s server, whoever runs it holds a switch.\n\nWe\'d rather no one did. So the model lives on your phone, and no server receives your questions.
One download at setup. Then airplane mode is fine: BOAR answers from the library on your phone, with llama.cpp built in, and shows the articles it used.
Every answer records how it ran: the model, time to the first word, tokens per second, memory and sources. Measure your own phone in Menu → Evaluation.
Before a model loads, BOAR checks it against your phone\'s memory. Downloads stay within a 50 GB storage budget.

Under each answer, tap the time and speed for the details (time to the first word, context, model); live speed in the header while BOAR answers; memory and storage at the bottom of the menu; This phone in Settings.
Fastest answers: the fast cores only, prompts read in bigger batches (the first word about twice as soon in our tests), no time limit. More heat and battery.
Auto: what we measured best on real phones. Balanced.
Cooler and longer battery: 2 threads, a smaller context, no reasoning, 5 minutes at most per step. Slower answers.
For a hot phone: 1 thread, small prompt batches, a smaller context, no reasoning, 5 minutes at most per step. The slowest.

Breaks your question into smaller questions, researches each one, then writes one answer. It runs several steps on the same model, so it is slower than a normal reply. It works with any style, which sets the tone. Deep Research with Succinct still gives a short answer.

BOAR measures every answer on your own phone: model load time, time to the first word, tokens per second, peak memory and which sources were used. Run the built-in evaluation from Settings → Advanced tweaks → Evaluation to compare installed models on the same questions, or run it from a computer over adb (see AGENTS.md on GitHub).
Fastest answers. The phone gets warmer and uses more battery, and answers have no time limit (use Stop). Best while charging.

Caps how long a single answer can be. Lower is faster and easier on the battery.

Free memory when I leave BOAR
Shortly after you leave, when nothing is being answered, BOAR unloads the model, so the phone doesn\'t close BOAR to get its memory back. The next answer takes a few seconds longer to start.

BOAR Knowledge and your Personal Files
BOAR Knowledge is the Vital Articles library on your phone. Import your notes, PDFs and spreadsheets into Personal Files, then ask about them with the Personal Files style.
Swap the answer model, find more on Hugging Face, and let BOAR free the memory when you leave it.
